item.title: Gov. Abbott announces Federal Assistance for '8 Ball' fire
item.description: Today, officials with the office of Governor Greg Abbott announced that the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) has approved a request from the State of Texas for a Fire Management Assistance Grant (FMAG) for the "8 Ball" fire.

item.title: COA: Opportunity to resolve citations, warrants from Feb. 9 - March 6
item.description: The city of Amarillo announced that its Municipal Court Compliance Campaign, allowing residents to resolve citations or warrants, runs from Feb. 9 through March 6.

item.title: WT Alumni invited back to campus for Happy Hour, free basketball games
item.description: The West Texas A&M University Alumni Association invites Buffaloes in the area back to campus for a happy hour event followed by two basketball games.

item.title: Nazareth teen goes from the show ring to a growing leather business
item.description: For Nazareth native Cheseny Farris, agriculture has always been more than a lifestyle, it has been the foundation of everything she does.

item.title: '8 Ball' Fire in Armstrong County near Highway 287, 13,500 acres; 60% contained
item.description: The Friends of the Armstrong County Fire Departments issued an advisory that crews were responding to a reported grass fire near Highway 287 and County Road 29 on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: 'Lavender' Fire in Oldham, Potter counties 18,423 acres burned; 40% contained
item.description: Fire crews are working a fire that started in Oldham County and is burning into Potter County.

item.title: Fire warning issued Tuesday after wildfire reported in Beaver County
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a fire warning at around 11:50 a.m. on Tuesday on request by the Oklahoma Forestry Service, after reports of a wildfire three miles northeast of Beaver in Beaver County.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
